result.rationale: The migration line `execute("SELECT c.id ... WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'")[0]['id'].to_i` dereferences index [0] unconditionally. For sites where the embed_category site setting is blank/default (no matching category row), the INNER JOIN returns zero rows and `[0]` is nil, raising NoMethodError before the `if category_id == 0` fallback on the next lines ever runs. So the fallback intended for the blank case is unreachable — the migration crashes on default installations. Mechanism is fully visible in the diff.
